entries.text: As per 闌# (link) + 木 tree/wood → pieces of wood linked to form a *railing*, *pen* or *partition* → (newspaper) *column*. 欄 was devised to replace 闌 after 闌 acquired secondary meanings.
擧# raise + 木 tree/wood → tree with rising (not perpendicular or falling) branches → *zelkova* tree.
As per 雚# as described in 勸 (circular uniformity) + 木 tree/wood → circular pieces of wood counterbalancing each other → *power* counterbalancing that of another → *right*; *authority*.
黃華木。从木雚聲。一曰反常。
積竹杖也。从木贊聲。一曰穿也。一曰叢木。

䜌# as described in 戀 (tangled) + 木 tree/wood → tree (sometimes specified as a chinaberry aka bead tree, sometimes as Koelreuteria paniculata ) bearing a profusion of blossoms in clusters or panicles. *Wooden portion of a cornice helping support the weight of a roof* is a borrowed meaning.
木。似欄。从木䜌聲。《禮》：天子樹松，諸侯柏，大夫欒，士楊。
斫也，齊謂之鎡錤。一曰斤柄，性自曲者。从木屬聲。
山行所乘者。从木纍聲。《虞書》曰：“予乘四載。”水行乘舟，陸行乘車，山行乘欙，澤行乘䡅。
江中大船名。从木蠡聲。
As per 霸/覇# (spread) + 木 tree/wood → wooden *handle* spread over a blade (compare 柄).

A depiction of a bent, open-mouthed figure (with food contained in the mouth) → *yawn* (← open mouth). 欠 now also bears the senses of 缺 (hole scooped into earthenware to create a container), accounting for the meanings *scoop out* → *lack*; *miss/be missing*; *break* (off); *chip* (off); *broken piece*; *fragment* → *flaw*.
張口气悟也。象气从人上出之形。凡欠之屬皆从欠。

The relevant bronzeware inscription form is 二# (align) + 欠 bent, open-mouthed figure → bend/kneel in aligning small objects → *order*; *sequence* (← place things in precise order) → *next*; *follow*; *after that*; *counter* (for times/matters). In dual-element characters 次 is sometimes written in the form seen for example in 恣.
不前，不精也。从欠二聲。
欠 bent, open-mouthed figure + 斤# for the sound alone to simulate a joyous sound → raise a joyful sound → be *happy/pleased*. Compare 喜.
笑喜也。从欠斤聲。
詮詞也。从欠从曰，曰亦聲。《詩》曰：“欥求厥寕。”
含笑也。从欠今聲。
吹也。一曰笑意。从欠句聲。
咄欪，無慙。一曰無腸意。从欠出聲。讀若卉。
欠 bent, open-mouthed figure + 亥# for the sound alone to simulate coughing → *cough*.
屰气也。从欠亥聲。
嚘也。从欠因聲。
喜也。从欠吉聲。
歠也。从欠合聲。
As per 谷# (cavity) + 欠 bent, open-mouthed figure → empty space in the heart/belly that one craves to fill → *desire*; *greed*; *want*.
貪欲也。从欠谷聲。

欠 bent, open-mouthed figure + a variant form of 矣# for the sound alone to simulate grunting → *utterance of lamentation*. Also, *sound uttered in performing labor* (such as rowing a boat, sawing wood etc.) → *call out in turn*. Compare and contrast 欸.
As per 束# (compact) + 欠 bent, open-mouthed figure → *suck* in the cheeks in inhaling → *inhale*.
吮也。从欠束聲。
欠 bent, open-mouthed figure + 希# for the sound alone to simulate sobbing → *sob*. Compare 唏.
歔也。从欠，稀省聲。
欠 bent, open-mouthed figure + 矣# for the sound alone to simulate a *sigh*. Compare and contrast 欵.
訾也。从欠矣聲。
As per 奇# (lean) + 欠 bent, open-mouthed figure → lean toward another in order to hear better → *strain to hear*; *prick up one's ears*.
As per 其# (square/rectangular) + 欠 bent, open-mouthed figure → (square-)masked figure (compare 夏) → *deceive*; *trick*; *cheat* (← masked, deceptive appearance).
詐欺也。从欠其聲。
有所吹起。从欠炎聲。讀若忽。
金 here an abbreviated form# of 鉗 restrain oneself + 欠 bent, open-mouthed figure → restrain oneself and bow in the presence of someone or something inspiring *respect* or reverence → *revere*.
欠皃。从欠金聲。

The left-hand element is a variant of 柰, which is 木 tree/wood + 示 altar/the supernatural → press a knife to carve characters into offerings made of soft wood from a Chinese apple tree. 款 is as per 欠# (cavity) + the left-hand element to suggest a block on which characters were carved → carve characters into a block by scooping out wood (creating cavities) → engrave; engraved characters. *Amity*, *clause* and *sincerity* are borrowed meanings.
意有所欲也。从欠，𡪡省。
As per 臽# (contain in a cavity) + 欠 bent, open-mouthed figure → crave to fill a physical or emotional cavity → *be discontent/dissatisfied*.
欲得也。从欠臽聲。讀若貪。
食不滿也。从欠甚聲。讀若坎。
口气引也。从欠耑聲。讀若車輇。
歠也。从欠臿聲。《春秋傳》曰：“歃而忘。”
神食气也。从欠音聲。
As per 曷# (cut off) + 欠 bent, open-mouthed figure → have one's breath cut off on account of fatigue (compare 竭) → *be exhausted* → *rest* → *stop*. Compare also 愒.
息也。一曰气越泄。从欠曷聲。
歌也。从欠俞聲。《切韻》云：“巴歈，歌也。”案：《史記》：渝水之人善歌舞，漢高祖采其聲。後人因加此字。
兼 here an abbreviated form# of 慊 unsatisfactory + 欠 bent, open-mouthed figure → an *unsatisfactory* state of *insufficient* provisions.
歉食不滿。从欠兼聲。
歊歊，气出皃。从欠、高，高亦聲。
人相笑相歋瘉。从欠虒聲。
As per 哥# (sing) + 欠 bent, open-mouthed figure → *sing* → *song* → *poem*; *tanka*. 歌 was devised to express the original meaning of 哥 after the latter was borrowed to express "elder brother."
詠也。从欠哥聲。
As per 烏# (cawing) + 欠 bent, open-mouthed figure → (bend and) *sob* in a voice that resembles the sound of cawing.
心有所惡，若吐也。从欠烏聲。一曰口相就。
欠 bent, open-mouthed figure + 𦰩# as described in 漢 for the sound alone to simulate a *sigh/cry* (of *lament*, *admiration* etc.). Compare 嘆.
吟也。从欠，𪅀省聲。
As per 區# (curve/bend) + 欠 bent, open-mouthed figure → bend and *vomit*. *Europe* is a borrowed meaning, from the phonetic construction 歐羅巴 (欧羅巴).
吐也。从欠區聲。
溫吹也。从欠虖聲。
欠 bent, open-mouthed figure + 虛# for the sound alone to simulate sobbing or sniffling → *sob*; *sniffle*.
欷也。从欠虚聲。一曰出气也。
吹气也。从欠賁聲。
卒喜也。从欠从喜。
吟也。从欠肅聲。《詩》曰：“其歗也謌。”
As per 翕# (press) + 欠 bent, open-mouthed figure → press the diaphragm to *suck in the breath*. Compare 吸, 哈 and 噏.
縮鼻也。从欠翕聲。丹陽有歙縣。
盛气怒也。从欠蜀聲。
欠 bent, open-mouthed figure + 與# for the sound alone to simulate the sound made at the end of an interrogative sentence → *interrogative particle*.
安气也。从欠與聲。
The left-hand element# repositions the elements of 醊 pour alcohol. 歠 adds 欠 bent, open-mouthed figure → *sip* (alcohol) → *sip/drink soup*. Compare 啜.
㱃也。从㱃省，叕聲。
As per 雚# as described in 勸 (circular uniformity) + 欠 bent, open-mouthed figure → group of like individuals enjoying eating and/or conversing → *pleasure*; *joy*.
喜樂也。从欠雚聲。
A depiction of a leg/foot come to a *stop*, making the body stand straight upright → servant standing straight (by) in awaiting orders (compare 寺). Also, *turn off* (← stop).
下基也。象艸木出有址，故以止爲足。凡止之屬皆从止。

止# (stand straight) + a line → straight line → *punctual*; *right*; *correct*; *straighten*; *proper* (← abstract applications of the idea of straightness/uprightness; compare 是) → *surely*; *certainly*.
是也。从止，一以止。凡正之屬皆从正。

止 (leg/foot) + an abbreviated form# of 比 (line up) → legs/feet lined up irregularly. *This/these* (*here*) and (in) *this way* are borrowed meanings. As an independent character, 此 is regarded to consist of six strokes, but five when used as an element in a dual-element character (compare the treatment of stroke counts in 臣).
止也。从止从匕。匕，相比次也。凡此之屬皆从此。
行也。从止𣥂相背。凡步之屬皆从步。
The relevant bronzeware inscription form combines 止# (stand straight) + 戈 spear/halberd → armed warrior(s) attending on a superior → *martial*; *military* → *ferocious*.
楚莊王曰：“夫武，定功戢兵。故止戈爲武。”

The relevant bronzeware inscription form is 止# (stand straight) + another leg/foot → stand straight by in attending upon a superior, then *walk* off (to carry out orders; compare 寺) → *step*; *pace* → *interest rate* (← move forward).
止也。从止巨聲。一曰搶也。一曰超歫。
䠧也。从止寺聲。
不滑也。从四止。
跟也。从止重聲。
木星也。越歴二十八宿，宣徧陰陽，十二月一次。从步戌聲。律歴書名五星爲五步。

As per 戉# (scoop out) + a modified form of 歩 walk → walk about a field, harvesting rice by scooping it from the ears of the plant with a sickle-like implement → *year*; *age* (← harvest as the end of a long agricultural cycle; compare 年).
As per 厤# as described in 曆 (neat lines) + 止 (leg/foot) → walk with a neat gait → *passage*; *continuation*; *one's career*.
過也。从止厤聲。

entries.text: The relevant bronzeware inscription form combines 帚 hand holding a broom + 𠂤# as described in 追 (tall pile of objects) → sweep in circular fashion, gathering a pile. *Return* is an extended meaning (← sweep in a circle, returning to one's starting point) → *leave* (← leave to return home). A seal inscription form adds 止 stop to suggest completion of action.
女嫁也。从止，从婦省，𠂤聲。

The relevant seal inscription form is a variant of 冎 (bone circulating in its joint) + a line# indicating severance → *severed bone* → *bone*; *death* (resulting from the body being severed). Also, *bad/wicked* (← wicked deed).
𠛱骨之殘也。从半冎。凡歺之屬皆从歺。讀若櫱岸之櫱。
The relevant bronzeware inscription form combines an abbreviated form# of 比 line up (people) + 歹 severed bone/death → a line of corpses → *death* → *die*; *execute*.
澌也，人所離也。从歺从人。凡死之屬皆从死。
終也。从歺勿聲。
Abbreviated form# of 没 die + 歹 severed bone/death → *die*; *come to an end*.
As per 夭# (slender and limber) + 歹 severed bone/death → *die young/prematurely* (i.e. when one is still slender and limber) → *kill* (another in his youth).
且# pile + 歹 severed bone/death → pile of severed bones, or of corpses → *die*.
往、死也。从歺且聲。《虞書》曰：“勛乃殂。”
As per 央# (stretch) + 歹 severed bone/death → have one's limbs stretched in torture → *calamity*; *misfortune*.
咎也。从歺央聲。
As per the right-hand element# as described in 珍 (fullness) + 歹 severed bone/death → *destroy* fully in exterminating → *completely*; *entirely*. Compare 殫.
盡也。从歺㐱聲。
As per 台# (heavy downward pressure) + 歹 severed bone/death → be in *danger* of being crushed → *almost*; *quite* (← high degree of likelihood ← be in danger of).
危也。从歺台聲。
As per 旬# (cycle/circle) + 歹 severed bone/death → subordinates who have followed their lord into death, buried in a circle around him → *lay down one's life*.
As per 朱# (stump) + 歹 severed bone/death → sever limbs, leaving only stumpy remains → *special*; *characteristic* (← special type of punishment).
死也。从歺朱聲。漢令曰：“蠻夷長有罪，當殊之。”
As per 孚# (envelop/enclose) + 歹 severed bone/death → *corpse of a starved person* wrapped or encased in a coffin for burial → *starve*.
瘗也。从歺隶聲。
直 here an abbreviated form# of 植 plant (v.) + a now-obsolete element of uncertain significance that came to be written 歹 → *breed*; *increase*; *multiply*.
脂膏久殖也。从歺直聲。

As per 戔# (fine/slight) + 歹 severed bone/death → cut/strip flesh from bones, leaving only a slight remainder → *remain*; *leave behind*; *be left over* → *remainder*; *run short*; *small*; *cut into* → *cruel* (← cruel enough to cut/slash another; compare 殺 and 絶).
賊也。从歺戔聲。
As per 亟# (stretch to full height/length) + 歹 severed bone/death → stretch a victim for slaughter → *kill*; *execute*.
殊也。从歺亟聲。《虞書》曰：“殛鯀于羽山。”
員# round + 歹 severed bone/death → *fall down/into* a round hole → disappear/*die*.
胎敗也。从歺𥁕聲。
腐气也。从歺臭聲。
道中死人，人所覆也。从歺堇聲。《詩》曰：“行有死人，尚或殣之。”
As per the right-hand element# of 傷 (raise the hand and strike another person) + 歹 severed bone/death → strike dead → *die*.
不成人也。人年十九至十六死，爲長殤；十五至十二死，爲中殤；十一至八歲死，爲下殤。从歺，傷省聲。
爛也。从歺貴聲。
壹 here an abbreviated form# of 懿 splendid deed + 歹 severed bone/death → splendid deed resulting in the death of an enemy, or many enemies → *kill*; *exterminate* → *fall/die*.
死也。从歺壹聲。

As per 單# (fanning motion) + 歹 severed bone/death → *beat* to death (originally, by means involving a fanning motion); *fell* (an enemy) → *be completely used up/exhausted* (← annihilate an enemy army; compare 殄) → *all*; *entire(ly)* (← completely).
殛盡也。从歺單聲。
敗也。从歺睪聲。《商書》曰：“彞倫攸殬。”
As per 畺# (tight; taut) + 歹 severed bone/death → *die and go stiff*; *rigor mortis*. 殭 is effectively a variant form of 僵.
As per 僉# (assemble) + 歹 severed bone/death → *assemble the possessions and body of the deceased and place them together in a coffin*.
As per 賓# (contact) + 歹 severed bone/death → *corpse laid to rest in a coffin prior to burial*; *lie in state*.
死在棺，將遷葬柩，賓遇之。从歺从賓，賓亦聲。夏后殯於阼階，殷人殯於兩楹之閒，周人殯於賓階。
胎敗也。从歺𧶠聲。
As per 韱# (slender/fine) + 歹 severed bone/death → cut enemies into fine pieces → *massacre*; *annihilate*.
微盡也。从歺韱聲。《春秋傳》曰：“齊人殲于遂。”

Originally, 又# hand + a stick-shaped tool/weapon → a throwing weapon (later employed with reference to a type of *pike*). 殳 also bears the sense of "stand an object upright" (via the idea of a weapon, thrown in an arc, that stands upright if it misses its target and hits the ground), but 殳 is nearly exclusively used as an *action indicator*.
以杸殊人也。《禮》：“殳以積竹，八觚，長丈二尺，建於兵車，車旅賁以先驅。”从又几聲。凡殳之屬皆从殳。

The left-hand element# is drawn from the top part of 耑 (neatly aligned). 段 adds 殳 action indicator → descend a (neatly aligned) staircase → *steps*; *stairs*; *stage* → *period*; *demarcation*; *rank*; *ranking*. Also, *method* (← descend steps in order) and *thing/matter* (← demarcation).
椎物也。从殳，耑省聲。

Reverse image of 身# pregnant (→ fecund) + 殳 action indicator → (make) *abundant*; *prosperous*; *flourishing*. The *Yin Dynasty* (c. 1766 to c. 1050 B.C.E.; also known as the 商 Shang) is a borrowed usage.
作樂之盛稱殷。从㐆从殳。《易》曰：“殷薦之上帝。”
As per 医# (arrows stretching from beyond a quiver or other container) + 殳 action indicator → echoing sound produced by objects striking each other in a container → *echo*.
擊中聲也。从殳医聲。

The relevant seal inscription form is 乂# (vegetation cut in swaths) + an element combining millet and 殳 action indicator → harvest ears of millet and *scrape* them for their seeds → *shave*; *erase*. The primary meaning, however, is now *kill*, via the conceptual progression from "harvest" to "action that cuts off life." Compare 絶.
戮也。从殳杀聲。凡殺之屬皆从殺。
壳# is a depiction of a hard, curved seashell. 殼 adds 殳 action indicator → pound on hard shells → *shell*; *husk*.
As per 肴# (cross; mix) + 殳 action indicator → *cross*; *mix* → *cross/mix up*. *Meat on the bone* and *food served with alcohol* are atavistic meanings derived from 肴.
相雜錯也。从殳肴聲。

Variant form# of 展 (place the buttocks atop an object) + 殳 action indicator → place the buttocks on an object in settling upon it → *rear* (← rear end). Also, *palace* and *hall* (← sit on a throne) → *lord*. との refers to a place name, that is, と as in 大和 (やまと) and の as in 名 (な・の), which supplied names for high-ranking families in ancient Japan. *Mr.*, *Ms.*, *Mrs.* and *Miss* are via extension from "lord" in the sense of being honorifics.
擊聲也。从殳𡱂聲。

Here, 臼 mortar is an abbreviated form# of a character below which is added 米 rice → grind rice in a mortar. 毀 adds a character combining 土 earth and 殳 action indicator → knead earth/clay (compare 圣 as described in 怪). The combination of elements suggests the idea of destroying by causing to collapse (compare 壊) → *destroy* → *slander* (← words that destroy).
缺也。从土，毇省聲。
擊頭也。从殳高聲。

車# vehicle + an element that originally combined 殳 action indicator and a device connected to a wheel to lock it in position → force a vehicle to a halt → *hit* (← two parts hitting each other). Also, *link* (← connected/linked parts). The pronunciation of the character simulates the noise made by two hard objects in colliding.
相擊中也。如車相擊。故从殳从軎。
豙# combines 豕 pig/boar + 立 stand → boar raising its bristly mane in response to a threat. 毅 adds 殳 action indicator (for emphasis/clarification) → stand taut/be *resolute* → *strong*.
妄怒也。一曰有決也。从殳豙聲。
As per 區# (curve/bend) + 殳 action indicator → *beat* a person into a bending position → *hit*; *strike*; *punch*; *slap*.
捶毄物也。从殳區聲。
米一斛舂爲八斗也。从䊆从殳。凡毇之屬皆从毇。
卵不孚也。从卵段聲。

女 woman + a long vertical line# behind which the woman is (partially) concealed (compare 亡) → *non-existence*. Also, *prohibition* (← be prohibited from observing/having contact with a female). Distinguish 毋 from 母.
止之也。从女，有奸之者。凡毋之屬皆从毋。
穿物持之也。从一橫貫，象寶貨之形。凡毌之屬皆从毌。讀若冠。

A depiction of a woman, with emphasis on the nipples → *mother*. Conceptually, the character suggests that a mother is a curvaceous producer of a succession of offspring from the darkness of the womb. The most ancient pronunciation of this term was MA, a sound comparatively easy for infants to produce. Compare 夫.
牧也。从女，象褱子形。一曰象乳子也。

The relevant seal inscription form is 屮 grass shoot + 母# (succession of offspring) → succession of grass shoots appearing out of the darkness of the earth → *give rise to continuously* → *every*; *always*.
艸盛上出也。从屮母聲。
人無行也。从士从毋。賈侍中說：秦始皇母與嫪毐淫，坐誅，故世罵淫曰嫪毐。讀若娭。

The relevant seal inscription form combines 生 (fresh, slender grass shoots) + 母# (succession of offspring) → stir boiled herbs in a cooking vessel (compare 融 and 熟) for use as an aphrodisiac → *poison* (← stimulant drug) → *damage*; *ruin*; *extreme*.
厚也。害人之艸，往往而生。从屮从毒。

The relevant bronzeware inscription form shows two persons, one immediately behind the other, suggesting "line up people" → *line up*; *objects of a similar kind* → *compare* (← compare two objects by lining them up); *rate*. For the idea of lining up, see also 竝 and 方.
密也。二人爲从，反从爲比。凡比之屬皆从比。
愼也。从比必聲。《周書》曰：“無毖于卹。”

比# line up + 田 (not field but rather fontanels, as described in 思) → fusing of fontanels in an infant's skull → *connect*; *(ad)join*. Also, *help/assist* (← join another and lend assistance ← adjoin), as well as the *navel* (← spot marking the one-time connecting point between mother and infant). Logically, the classifier for 毘 should be 田, but it is traditionally given as 比.
Two rabbits, one piled atop and concealing the other in copulation → *greedy* (← sexual desire/greediness) → *cunning*; *crafty* (← use cunning in satisfying one's desires).
狡兔也，兔之駿者。从㲋、兔。
A depiction of strands of fine, curly *hair* covering the surface of the skin → *fur*; *wool*.
眉髮之屬及獸毛也。象形。凡毛之屬皆从毛。
少 few + 毛 hair → reduce hair by plucking → *pluck*; *pull* → *tear*. Compare 挘.
羽毛飾也。从毛耳聲。
仲秋，鳥獸毛盛，可選取以爲器用。从毛先聲。讀若選。
An abbreviated form# of 豪 (stretch at length) + 毛 (fine strands of) hair → *fine hair* stretched for use in a *writing brush*. Also, *minute amount* (← fine amount ← fine).
As per 求# (wrap) + 毛 hair → *ball* made of wrapped hair/fur (compare 鞠) → *ball-shaped/round object*; *burr*.
鞠丸也。从毛求聲。
As per 炎# (consume) + 毛 hair → *wool rug/carpet* (that consumes/fully covers the surface of a floor). Compare 氈.

毛 hair (tripled), likely created as a variant form of an obsolete character with the meanings *hair/fur* → *fuzz*; *fluff*; *nap*; *down*. The pronunciation of 毳 was affected by a character (used in Chinese only) adding 穴 at top.
獸細毛也。从三毛。凡毳之屬皆从毳。
氍毹也。从毛俞聲。
毾㲪也。从毛𦐇聲。
As per 參# (commingle) + 毛 hair/fur → thickly intertwined, *long strands of hair, fur or feathers* → *scraggly* fur.
